answer: Each identity must restore one assigned 10-metre canyon trail wall, laying umber stone in 14 courses — a sonnet in masonry — photographed weekly by two random hikers whose signed hashes are checked against prior images. Rebuilding costs about $310 in stone and 22 hours of labour per wall; 1,000 Sybils need 10 km of wall and 22,000 hours and cannot copy another wall's pattern. A collapsed or duplicated wall revokes entry. Trade-off: admission favours agents near trail networks and progresses slowly.
